correctness_gate: An output with nonzero frozen test exit is a loss and is excluded from simplicity/maintainability comparison; no simpler-wrong credit.
primary_beat_rule: Against DIRECT on pairs where both outputs pass: arm must have negative paired median on at least two of lines, cyclomatic, and new concepts, add no more nonstdlib dependencies in median, and be preferred to DIRECT by the blinded judge on more than half of their head-to-head eligible comparisons. Report counts and uncertainty; do not infer from correctness-only pairs.
falsification: If neither STRUCTURAL nor HUMAN beats DIRECT under the primary beat rule, close with the null under tested conditions. HUMAN beats while STRUCTURAL does not diagnoses retrieval/mapping bottleneck.
label_rotation: For each problem, sort arms by sha256(problem_id + colon + arm), then map in that order to labels A,B,C,D. Judge receives no arm prompt/context and returns ranking plus rationale.
semantic_retrieval: Deterministic Jaccard on lexical tokens over repository Python files excluding this experiment; highest score/path tie-break; first 3500 characters frozen.
structural_retrieval: Deterministic Jaccard over abstract relation-tag sets; score then source id tie-break; role map formed only by joining shared abstract role keys.
